title: Axolotl dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="20" ry="16" fill="#ffb3d1"/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#ffe0ee"/>
  
  <!-- Left arm (up) -->
  <path d="M30 55 Q22 42 18 32" stroke="#ff9ec4" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="17" cy="30" r="5" fill="#ffb3d1"/>
  <circle cx="16" cy="27" r="2.5" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
  
  <!-- Right arm (up) -->
  <path d="M70 55 Q78 42 82 32" stroke="#ff9ec4" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="83" cy="30" r="5" fill="#ffb3d1"/>
  <circle cx="84" cy="27" r="2.5" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
  
  <!-- Left leg -->
  <path d="M42 78 Q38 88 34 92" stroke="#ff9ec4" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="94" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#ffb3d1"/>
  
  <!-- Right leg -->
  <path d="M58 78 Q62 88 66 92" stroke="#ff9ec4" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="94" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#ffb3d1"/>
  
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M72 60 Q86 56 90 48 Q92 44 89 46 Q84 50 78 52" stroke="#ff9ec4" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="#ffb3d1"/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="20" ry="16" fill="#ffb3d1"/>
  
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="43" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#ff7eb0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="43" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#ff7eb0" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="35" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#2a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="33.5" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="35" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#2a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="33.5" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M44 45 Q50 51 56 45" stroke="#d4547a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Gills (left) -->
  <path d="M32 28 Q24 22 20 16" stroke="#ff7eb0" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M31 32 Q22 30 16 26" stroke="#ff7eb0" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M33 36 Q26 38 20 36" stroke="#ff7eb0" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Gills (right) -->
  <path d="M68 28 Q76 22 80 16" stroke="#ff7eb0" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M69 32 Q78 30 84 26" stroke="#ff7eb0" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M67 36 Q74 38 80 36" stroke="#ff7eb0" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Gills tip balls (left) -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="16" r="3" fill="#ff5c9e"/>
  <circle cx="16" cy="26" r="3" fill="#ff5c9e"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="36" r="3" fill="#ff5c9e"/>
  
  <!-- Gills tip balls (right) -->
  <circle cx="80" cy="16" r="3" fill="#ff5c9e"/>
  <circle cx="84" cy="26" r="3" fill="#ff5c9e"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="36" r="3" fill="#ff5c9e"/>
  
  <!-- Dance motion lines -->
  <path d="M14 50 Q10 48 8 52" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M86 50 Q90 48 92 52" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M20 70 Q16 72 18 76" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M80 70 Q84 72 82 76" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Music notes -->
  <path d="M88 60 L88 52 Q92 52 92 56" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="60" r="3" fill="#ffe066"/>
  
  <path d="M10 44 L10 36 Q6 36 6 40" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="44" r="3" fill="#ffe066"/>
</svg>
